name: cmp
summary: Compare two files byte by byte and report the first difference

options.description: also show the differing bytes, as octal and as characters
skip the first SKIP bytes of both inputs (SKIP1:SKIP2: different counts); SKIP1 and SKIP2 may also follow the file names
list every differing byte: its position and both values in octal
print nothing; only the exit status tells

exitCodes.2: trouble (a missing file, a bad option)

messages.eofInLine: EOF on {file} after byte {byte}, in line {line}
